coordinate_system: Authoring X/Y horizontal, Z up. Runtime X/-Z horizontal, Y up.
scale_policy: Human dimensions establish a coherent working scale. Canon does not supply a survey. Unmeasured metric dimensions remain inferred, including dimensions of observed silhouettes.

leaf.name: Konohagakure

Hokage office in front of the monument
Dense low urban fabric, varied rounded and rectangular buildings, colored roofs
Large entrance gates and enclosing wall, forest outside
constrained: Office, monument and main approach maintain their repeated relative relationship
inferred: Metric distances between incompletely documented districts

sand.name: Sunagakure
observed: Dense rounded towers with varied profiles
Warm earthen architecture with horizontal slit-window bands
provisional_observed: Bulging Kazekage office with wind medallion and stepped crown
Narrow entrance cleft through the enclosing escarpment
constrained: Settlement occupies most of the interior basin
Architecture must remain lower than its enclosing rim

Construction joints, doors and functional street equipment
Absolute basin diameter and office dimensions

mist.name: Kirigakure
mist.era: Shippuden, Mei's tenure around the Five Kage Summit
observed: Narrow towers with dense horizontal openings rise below enclosing steep mountains
Low horizontal mist lies between forest and architecture
provisional_observed: Broad cylindrical Mizukage complex with tiled roof and large arched entrance
Tall masonry enclosure walls with archways
Planted roof edges and smaller cylindrical dwellings
constrained: Forest, steep surrounding relief and architecture overlap in depth
Cylindrical monumental complex remains distinct from narrow residential towers
inferred: Unseen connections between public courts and residential lanes
Metric scale beyond human-scale foreground paving
exclude: Blank flat ground concealed by opaque fog

cloud.name: Kumogakure
cloud.era: Shippuden, Fourth Raikage's tenure before the war
provisional_observed: Mountain pinnacles penetrate occupied terrace rings
Large blue office narrows toward its suspended lower end
Office has horizontal galleries, vertical ribs, planted crown and an upper lookout
Clouds cross the occupied elevation range
Elevated routes and railings connect mountain construction
constrained: Buildable terraces follow separate rock masses at different elevations
Central office silhouette dominates the panorama without replacing the mountain skyline
inferred: Exact bridge connections not visible in the source
Absolute mountain elevation and office dimensions
exclude: A flat city with a mountain backdrop
Generic pagodas substituted for the ribbed blue office

stone.name: Iwagakure
stone.era: Shippuden, Ohnoki's tenure around the Five Kage Summit
observed: Occupied stone formations have steep exposed faces
Arched galleries wrap rock at multiple heights
Vertical water runnels occur on some rock faces
Sparse vegetation collects at protected rock feet
constrained: Built galleries and exposed geology form a single structural mass
Usable routes must negotiate substantial elevation changes
inferred: Full settlement graph beyond the departure frame
Metric sizes and unshown stair connections
